cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Hope Keeps Moving
cards.instruction: Turn every disappointment into a new reason the desired outcome is delayed, redirected, or becoming more meaningful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll open elsewhere. Our bookshop failed here because we're meant to find different readers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we're meant to start with one shelf. You choose; I'll carry the books.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I could get us a market stall beside the bus stop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: People waiting with nothing to read. Book it; I'll pack the short stories.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 takes charge of reopening elsewhere; A3 reframes lack of money as intended smaller scale and offers carrying; A5 adopts B market route as the audience to serve.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 no moving money supports one-shelf scale; B4 possible stall is acted on as a booking task, not an already completed arrangement.

relationship.evidence: B2 supplies a real financial limit and B4 helps solve it with local access.

heightening.evidence: B4 bus-stop waiting makes A5 select short stories and divide booking from packing.

specificity.evidence: A1 failed bookshop and B2 money establish the business need, but A3 you choose can name the books more directly.

brevityWit.evidence: A3 you choose is an avoidable vague object in otherwise concrete labor sharing; make that small line edit.
